title: Water Rationing
description: Plain-text guide built on official advice not to ration drinking water: conservation levels that cut other uses, ways to reduce how much water your body needs, and low-water hygiene. Covers infants, children, older adults, dehydration signs, and when to call 911.
shortDescription: Cut every use but drinking, reduce your body's need, and spot dehydration
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
